requirement_vague: Test the password recovery flow of a new user. Superuser credentials: (admin@example.com / password123)

omissions.description: The code does not implement a password recovery flow. There is no endpoint to request password-recovery HTML content for a user's email, no endpoint to submit a password reset using a reset token, and no mechanism to generate or validate password reset tokens.
omissions.reasoning: The requirement describes a multi-step password recovery flow: (1) GET/POST to retrieve password-recovery HTML for a given email, (2) POST to submit a reset token and new password. Neither of these endpoints exists in the code. The only password-related endpoint is PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password, which requires the current password rather than a reset token.
